title: Azoth model spec
description: A model spec: what a machine accepts, what it computes, the procedure it runs and where it is valid. The machines to run are instances and live in `specs/cases/`, against `case.schema.json`.

id.description: Dotted identifier, e.g. eos.pure_saturation. Same rule as a calc id: it must match the module and function names in both implementations.

kind.description: What this model's spec fixes. `procedure` means a loop: a scheme, a convergence rule, a tolerance and a cap, which both implementations run. `direct` means a computation over vectors with no iteration, and no `algorithm` block.

inputs.description: Input quantities, keyed by parameter name. A calc's inputs are all scalars; a model's may be vectors and matrices.

outputs.description: Output quantities, keyed by result field name.

then.description: A procedure is a loop, so it requires an `algorithm` block.

else.description: A direct model has no loop, so it must not carry an `algorithm` block.

quantity.description: A scalar, vector, matrix or component list. Extends the calc `$defs.quantity` with the extra shapes a mixture needs.

components_quantity.description: A list of substance names, resolved against the shipped component databank (`data/components/`) with any keycard overlay applied. This is the input a calculation names its fluid by; a name carries no unit, so it declares none.

length.description: What the length means, e.g. 'one entry per component'. Prose rather than a number, because the model is written for any N.

optional.description: Whether a caller may leave the list out. Absent means required, which is the shape every fluid-naming input has; a list the model *defaults* - the rate-based packed column's transfer whitelist, whose default is the union of its inlets' components - states `true`.

value.description: A case value: a number, a composition vector, or a matrix stated as rows. Extends the calc `$defs.value` with numeric vectors and matrices.

length.description: What the length means, e.g. 'one entry per component'. Prose rather than a number, because the model is written for any N.

optional.description: Optional inputs may be omitted; an omitted vector is absent rather than empty, and the implementation must say what it then does. The scalar shape carries the same property through `calc.schema.json`; this branch is for a model whose vector input is a degree of freedom rather than a requirement - `process.absorption_column`'s per-tray pins are the first.

length.description: What the length means, e.g. 'one entry per phase'. Prose rather than a number, because the model is written for any N.

shape.description: The matrix's shape, e.g. 'N x N, symmetric, zero diagonal'.

algorithm.description: The procedure, stated completely enough that two implementations run the same one: its scheme, its stopping rule, its tolerance and its cap.

scheme.description: The procedure's name, e.g. saturation_pressure_bisection. Held to the implementations by python/tests/models/test_model_contract.py, the way `solver.kind` is held by test_solver_contract.py.

initialisation.description: How the iteration starts, where the scheme needs a starting point. The analogue of a solver's `initial_guess`; `wilson` is the K-value correlation.

inner.description: A nested procedure the outer one runs each iteration, with the same shape as an outer algorithm.

fallback.description: A nested procedure the outer one switches to when its own scheme has not converged after `after` steps. Unlike `inner`, which runs every iteration, this replaces the outer scheme for the rest of the solve - it is what a slowly-converging outer loop hands over to, and it carries its own stopping rule because it converges on a different measure.

after.description: How many outer steps run before the handover, counted in the outer scheme's own iterations. A value at or above `max_iterations` means the fallback never runs, which is a spec that has stopped describing its implementation.

initial_temperature.description: Where a quasi-Newton inversion of a property starts, in kelvin. The isentropic and isenthalpic flashes iterate from a temperature rather than bracketing one, so the spec states the start.

bracket.description: How the interval the iteration starts from is found. Part of the scheme rather than an implementation detail: two implementations that bracket differently find different roots when there is more than one.

lower.description: Where the search starts, in the reduced variable the scheme names, dimensionless.

steps.description: How many points the search evaluates, at least 2. It quantises the bracket: the interval the iteration then refines is only as tight as this step size.

inputs.description: Input values in the units declared in `inputs`; a vector or matrix input is stated as an array.
